description: Frozen authored bilingual engineering retrieval regression set, not a real user distribution. Relevance requires the strategy to apply to the query as written, considering its trigger and conditions; a category/id prefix does not determine relevance. A lesson that only mentions the queried failure as a counterexample under a different applicability condition is not relevant. Generic checklists are not relevant. Exact strategy duplicates remain relevant documents and are separately measured. Version 2 corrects semantic label errors in version 1 without changing queries, memory texts, confidences or retrieval parameters. Do not alter labels after evaluating this version.
